text: The Tenant Issues Committee on February 9, 2018 had before it a presentation from Jim Jessop, Deputy Fire Chief and Director, Fire Prevention and Public Education, Fire Services on Toronto Fire Services High Rise Residential Inspection Portal.

The Executive Committee: 1. Referred the item to Fire Chief and General Manager, Fire Services and the Chief Information Officer with a request to include an analysis on providing open data on fire inspections and report to the Community Development and Recreation Committee.
